errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The account logged in is not the repository's owner.

main.description: Takes the branch out of the protected branches of the repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as `knotless branch protect --undo` does. Its owner can, logged in to this appview's web pages: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account, which the pages' session cookie names. For an organization's repository, so can an admin who joined it, logged in to the pages or with a service token from their own PDS for this method: the appview's gateway, which the organization delegated its writes to, writes as the organization.

description: Stops protecting a branch of a repository.
